version: LOCK 21 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - worship: the last ten nights and Eid al-Fitr
builds_on: LOCK 18 calendar, LOCK 19 Ramadan (masjid, private record). Placeholders: {n}.
night_button: Stand in prayer through the night
night_toast: You pray in the dark masjid until your legs ache. Nobody knows which of these nights is the Night of Power. You seek it anyway.

fitr.title: Zakat al-fitr
fitr.text: Idris weighs a measure of dates into the sack for the poor. “Before the Eid prayer,” he says, “so that every home in River Market can eat on Eid.”
fitr.pay: Give a measure of dates · {n} coins
fitr.given: Your measure is in the sack.

eid.title: Eid al-Fitr
eid.text: The whole of River Market prays in the open ground by the masjid. Afterwards Rashid hugs you, Salma's children run past in new clothes, and Yunus the muezzin presses sweets into your hand: “Eid Mubarak!”

record.nights: Nights stood in the last ten
